---
title: "data analysis practice"
---
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")
gt(head(rhinovirus))

ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y= temperature_c
  
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red")


```
